## Confirmation ladder

| tier | cost target | what it buys |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `T0` | 30 s | correctness smoke plus ONE stage-profiled sample on the proxy fixture; the claimed phase must move here before T1 is scheduled. One warmup is the floor, not a nicety: the Cairo arm records its mandatory phase profile on a discarded warmup, so warmups=0 would leave that track with no phase evidence at all. |
| `T1` | 300 s | paired ABBA on proxy fixtures with sequential early stopping and the PoW-excluded boundary; never ranks. |
| `T2` | 2700 s | full dual-boundary paired run on the contributor host, real classes, guards impact-mapped; the claimed verdict. |
| `T3` | judge-scheduled | judge-scheduled re-run plus audits on the designated host; the scored row. No cost target — the judge never trades honesty for time. |

T0 and T1 never rank; they gate scheduling. The claimed (T2) and ranked (T3) numbers always keep the full dual boundary — the ranked number never excludes anything (TRACKS §3.5).
